subject.title: fix(zalo): bound proxy fetcher cache to 64 entries

question: Should disposable proxy-fetch lifecycle remain owned inside the Zalo plugin, or become a documented typed Plugin SDK contract shared by all affected channel caches?
rationale: The current branch avoids an explicit SDK addition by creating a private Symbol.for contract, but repository policy requires maintainers to choose and own intentional plugin-boundary expansion.

options.title: Keep Lifecycle Zalo-Local
options.body: Retain the cache bound but keep the dispatcher and its close ownership inside Zalo so eviction and monitor shutdown can use an explicit local lifecycle.

options.title: Add Typed SDK Handle
options.body: Introduce a documented disposable proxy-fetch handle through the Plugin SDK and migrate every bundled cache that shares the lifecycle invariant in the same change.

options.title: Accept Private Marker
options.body: Merge the hidden Symbol.for contract and accept silent compatibility drift and incomplete static enforcement across the plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep Lifecycle Zalo-Local
recommendation.body: Retain the cache bound but keep the dispatcher and its close ownership inside Zalo so eviction and monitor shutdown can use an explicit local lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history spans both channel runtime ownership and deliberate Plugin SDK surface reduction, making them the best available owner for this boundary choice.
